or"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" enabled perspectives to the configured endpoint. For tool approvals, it also includes approval
meta"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"data and tool arguments when found in the session. **Turning off conversation context does
not remov"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"e these decision inputs.**
- Credential masking covers common token/password assignments, Bearer tok"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ens, `sk-…` keys,
private-key blocks, and URL credentials. It **cannot detect every secret or person"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"al datum**.
Inspect the confirmation preview before sending sensitive content. Request/response JSON"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" may
contain conversation data; do not share it as sanitized diagnostics.
- Confirmation uses the ex"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"act local snapshot, valid for two minutes. Changes to request identity
or evaluation settings invali"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"date it. Preparation itself does not call Jev.
- The complete evaluation JSON has a **64 KiB UTF-8**"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" budget. Context is reduced first;
oversized decision inputs are rejected locally rather than silent"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ly cut.
- One HTTP request can contain several evaluations. Perspective comparison can increase API "},{"id":"p12s12","text":"usage;
one request does **not** mean one fixed-cost question. The card shows token usage when Jev re"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"turns it.
- Identical concurrent evaluations share an upstream call within one host. Cancellation ca"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"nnot
undo work already processed or guarantee a billing refund. Reopening a completed result reuses "},{"id":"p12s15","text":"it;
reopening a cancelled request in on-demand mode waits for **Ask Jev**.
- Answers are bound to th"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"e current session, interaction and request. Invalid, incomplete or stale

- Ordinary single-choice “none of the above”"},{"id":"p12s18","text":" results require a manual answer. The plan-review

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Compatibility and limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- The only DSH version declaration is an open-ended floor: `"engines.dsh": ">=0.2.0-rc.2"`. There is"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"
no upper bound and no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer, so DSH never refuses the plugin after a runtime
upd"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ate, and the market shows a definite **compatible** badge instead of **unknown/undeclared**
(an empt"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"y declaration is what produces *unknown*). Verified against **0.2.1-rc.3**; every newer
runtime stay"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"s inside the range. Add a ceiling only if a future runtime really breaks a public
interaction API. I"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ndividual features still depend on those host APIs.
- The card follows the main session's pending in"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"teraction; only when that session has none does
it fall back to another supported pending interactio"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"n. Historical or closed interactions are excluded.
- Free-text-only questions are not supported. A m"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ixed batch containing unsupported questions
cannot be adopted as a complete batch.
- The card uses `"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"shell.overlay` and `settings.section`. Sidebar avoidance is manual; switch sides
or collapse the car"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"d if it overlaps another panel.
- Context is capped at roughly 24,000 characters and may be shortene"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"d further by the byte budget.
Only overload responses `429` and `529` are retried, at most twice."}],"truncated":true}
